column1: # Book 4 second-round read (Fable, 2026-10-30): every line read against the Latin. No changes.
# 4.72 iacere ac largiri are active, with colorem (74) as object: things throw off and give out their color.
# 4.83 correpta luce diei: the daylight is pent in by the awnings, not drawn in.

column2: For certainly we see many things throw off and give out,
laughs, now that the light of day is pent within.
